We are currently seeking a highly skilled Quality Engineering Officer to join our team and drive technical optimization across our manufacturing operations.  The Quality Engineering Officer will play a critical role in optimizing our packaging production lines and manufacturing technologies. You will be responsible for analysing system performance, implementing process improvements, and ensuring that our manufacturing workflows operate at peak efficiency, quality, and compliance. Conduct root cause analysis on equipment failures and process anomalies, implementing engineering-based solutions to restore and enhance operational reliability. Assess production methods against established technical specifications and engineering standards to ensure all manufacturing processes remain within defined parameters.  Provide hands-on technical guidance and troubleshooting for production machinery and process technologies to mitigate downtime and boost system output.  Design, refine, and enforce technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and process controls to maintain consistency in production outcomes.  Partner with production, quality, and engineering teams to streamline packaging systems and refine manufacturing workflows.  Participate in the commissioning, testing, and validation of new manufacturing assets to ensure they meet performance and engineering benchmarks.  Develop and oversee testing and inspection protocols to verify process capability and maintain rigorous product performance standards. Proficiency in utilising ERP systems (e.g., SAP or Microsoft Dynamics 365) for production data analysis and operational monitoring. At A & M Packaging, our team members are dedicated professionals who take pride in their technical expertise and contribute directly to the innovation and operational success of our manufacturing operations. result.description: SDO  The Production Engineer is responsible for planning, developing and optimising manufacturing processes for the production of optical fibre current sensors, optical current transformers, transducers and related electrical monitoring equipment. The role focuses on improving manufacturing efficiency, product quality and production performance through engineering analysis, process optimisation and continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with engineering specifications, quality standards and workplace safety requirements.   Benefits   Task & responsibilities   Duties:    Plan and improve manufacturing processes for the production of optical fibre current sensors, current transformers, transducers and related electrical products.  Analyse production processes and identify opportunities to improve productivity, product quality and manufacturing efficiency.  Prepare and maintain manufacturing documentation, including work instructions, standard operating procedures (SOPs) and process specifications.  Coordinate production activities to ensure products are manufactured on time and meet quality standards.  Investigate production issues, equipment faults and product defects, and implement corrective actions.  Monitor production performance and recommend process improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce waste.  Support the introduction of new products through production trials, process validation and manufacturing implementation.  Evaluate manufacturing equipment and recommend upgrades or process improvements to improve production performance.  Ensure manufacturing activities comply with engineering specifications, quality standards, workplace health and safety requirements and relevant Australian standards.  Work closely with Engineering, Quality, Production and Supply Chain teams to support continuous improvement and achieve production objectives.    Responsibilities:    Ensure manufacturing processes operate efficiently and achieve production and quality targets.  Maintain accurate engineering and production documentation.  Provide technical support to production staff and assist in resolving manufacturing issues.  Monitor product quality and ensure compliance with engineering specifications and company standards.  Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and implement practical engineering solutions.  Support equipment commissioning, process validation and engineering change implementation.  Ensure compliance with Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) policies and company procedures.  Collaborate with internal teams to support production planning and timely customer delivery.     Qualification & experience   Bachelor's degree or higher in Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.  Minimum of one (1) year of relevant full-time work experience as a Production Engineer or in a similar manufacturing engineering role.  Knowledge of manufacturing processes, production planning and process improvement.  Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.  Understanding of quality management systems and workplace health and safety (WHS) requirements.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.  Good communication and teamwork skills.  Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with ERP/MRP systems or manufacturing software is an advantage.   About Company    Founded in Sydney in 2004, Smart Digital Optics (SDO) manufactures optical fibre current sensors for the electric power and smelting industries. Smart Digital Optics is one of the first companies to incorporate optical fibre current sensors into power monitoring and metering systems allowing users to measure electric currents with unprecedented levels of accuracy and ease. The digitally compatible and compact SDO products offer superior utility and performance compared to costly and cumbersome traditional approaches.  In 2010 SDO formed a strategic alliance with the Arteche Group. Arteche has 65 years of experience in the manufacture of electrical power products for generation, transmission, distribution and industrial applications. As an international benchmark with equipment in service in over 150 countries, it has companies in Europe, America, Asia and Oceania, as well as a service network comprised of more than 80 technical and sales offices.  The combination of SDO’s technology expertise with Arteche’s long experience in the electricity sector provides customers with a partner well equipped to support the introduce new technology for advanced transmission and industrial systems.   Technology :   SDO uses its expertise in advanced optics and signal processing to develop solutions for power engineering applications.  SDO’s optical current sensors utilize the Faraday effect in optical fibre, whereby the state of polarization of the light propagating in the fibre interacts with the magnetic field around a conductor.This effect is highly linear and provides the basis of an ultra high bandwidth, wide dynamic range current sensor which measures both AC and DC current with high accuracy. result.description:
Join a high-performing engineering team delivering complex, cutting-edge defence programmes   
   
  Competitive daily rate | Brisbane | Defence Industry | 12-Month Contract  
   
 An exciting opportunity exists for a Mechanical Engineer to join a leading Defence organisation supporting the delivery of a major capability program. Working within a multidisciplinary engineering team, you will play a key role in the design, development and integration of complex products and systems throughout the engineering lifecycle. 
 This position would suit someone with a strong background in mechanical design, product development or engineering design within Defence, aerospace, automotive, rail, heavy industry or other highly regulated engineering environments. 
   
   
  Key Responsibilities  
    
 
 Develop and maintain mechanical designs, engineering drawings and technical documentation. 
 Support design reviews, engineering change processes and configuration management activities. 
 Produce and update 3D CAD models and detailed manufacturing drawings. 
 Work closely with systems, manufacturing, quality and project engineering teams to deliver engineering outcomes. 
 Conduct engineering investigations, design analysis and problem-solving activities. 
 Ensure designs meet customer, safety, regulatory and compliance requirements. 
 Support prototype, testing, verification and validation activities as required. 
 Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and design optimisation activities. 
 
   
   
  What you'll need to succeed    
   
 
 Degree qualified in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline. 
 Experience within Defence, aerospace, automotive, rail, manufacturing or another complex engineering environment. 
 Strong mechanical design and product development experience. 
 Proficiency with CREO and/or CAD software (SolidWorks, Inventor, CATIA, NX or similar considered). 
 Experience producing engineering drawings and technical documentation. 
 Understanding of engineering lifecycles, design reviews and configuration management processes. 
 Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills. 
 Ability to work within multidisciplinary project teams. 
 
     
  Desirable  
   
   
 
 Experience working on Defence programs. 
 Understanding of systems engineering principles. 
 Exposure to AS9100, ISO9001 or similar quality standards. 
 Eligibility to obtain and maintain an Australian Defence Security Clearance. 
 
   
   
  What you'll get in return    
   
 
 12-month contract with extension potential. 
 Highly attractive daily rates. 
 Opportunity to work on a major Defence capability program. 
 Brisbane-based role with flexible work arrangements. 
 Collaborative engineering environment with cutting-edge technology and complex projects. 
 Career-enhancing opportunity supporting nationally significant Defence outcomes. 
 
   
   
  What you need to do now  
   
 If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV to lauryn.reddick@hays.com.au 
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.  Please  click here  to apply.

Assist Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists in the design, development and refinement of mechanical equipment, components and production systems by interpreting technical specifications, client requirements and engineering concepts.   Select appropriate drafting methods, CAD tools, design software and engineering resources to support efficient design development, manufacturing processes and project delivery.   Support the assembly and installation of new and modified mechanical assemblies, components and equipment by preparing accurate fabrication drawings, workshop documentation and technical instructions for production teams.   Estimate material quantities, prepare Bills of Materials (BOMs), determine component requirements and assist in assessing manufacturing resources and production needs for engineering projects.   Assist with engineering testing activities by reviewing design performance, evaluating manufacturing outcomes and supporting investigations to ensure equipment and components meet operational requirements.   Collect, analyse and interpret engineering data, perform technical calculations and prepare diagrams, drawings and documentation to support design development, manufacturing processes and project planning.   Coordinate and support inspection, quality assurance and maintenance activities by maintaining drawing registers, revision records and technical documentation to ensure the accuracy and traceability of engineering information.   Ensure all designs, drawings, fabrication documentation and completed work comply with applicable Australian Standards, engineering specifications, quality requirements, safety regulations and contractual obligations, while implementing modifications and continuous improvements where required.       Qualifications & Experience    Diploma or higher qualification in Engineering Drafting, Engineering Design, Mechanical Drafting, or a related field.   Minimum 1-3 years of relevant mechanical drafting experience.   Proficiency in CAD software such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, and Inventor.   Strong knowledge of fabrication processes, manufacturing methods, materials, and tolerances.   Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications accurately.   Excellent attention to detail, communication, and teamwork skills.      About Company     SPARTAN EQUIPMENTS AUSTRALIA PTY LTD (trading as Spartan Quip) is a Western Australian engineering and manufacturing company specialising in the design, fabrication and supply of heavy transport equipment and custom trailer solutions. The company manufactures a range of products including semi-trailers, tippers, drop deck trailers, skel trailers, dolly trailers and other specialised transport equipment for the transport, mining, construction and logistics industries. Spartan Quip provides engineering, drafting, manufacturing and compliance-focused solutions tailored to customer requirements and operates from its facility in Maddington, Western Australia .
